title: StackQL Query Library front matter
description: Schema for the YAML front matter of query library entries under query-library/queries/. The entry id is derived from the file path (provider/service/slug) and is not declared in front matter because Docusaurus reserves the id key.

title.description: Short human title, unique across the library.

description.description: One or two sentences. Drives index.json, the catalogue, JSON-LD and OG metadata.

format.description: Must be the literal string md. Forces Docusaurus to parse the page as CommonMark so braces in prose cannot break the MDX compiler.

verb.description: Tool routing verb. select -> run_select_query, mutation -> run_mutation_query, lifecycle -> run_lifecycle_operation. The mutation boolean in emitted JSON is derived from this.

status.description: deprecated entries are excluded from search results by the MCP server but their URLs keep resolving.

providers.description: StackQL provider names. The first element must equal the first path segment of the entry id.

services.description: StackQL service names touched by the query. Must include the second path segment of the entry id.

tags.description: Search facet tags (lowercase). Filterable in query_library_search.

keywords.description: Secondary retrieval terms: synonyms and jargon (e.g. bucket list, opt-in status).

intent_keywords.description: Primary retrieval field. Phrase these exactly as users phrase asks, e.g. 'list all s3 buckets'.

auth.description: Environment variable names the query needs at execution time. Names only, never values.

permissions.description: Provider-native permissions/actions required to execute the template, eg iam:ListUsers, Microsoft.Compute/virtualMachines/read, resourcemanager.projects.list. Declare only what the template's wire calls require; omit entirely when unsure - this feeds least-privilege policy generation and 403 remediation guidance.

params.description: Declared template parameters. Every {{placeholder}} in the template must be declared here and every declared param must appear in the template.

name.description: Placeholder name as it appears inside {{ }} in the template.

type.description: identifier values are validated against ^[A-Za-z_][A-Za-z0-9_-]*$ and inserted verbatim; string/enum values are escaped for the quoted literal position they occupy.

default.description: Value used when the caller omits the param. A param with a default is effectively optional.

example.description: Realistic example value. Required when there is no default; used by CI for the template render check.

enum.description: Allowed values when type is enum.

pattern.description: Go RE2 regular expression the value must match (string params only).

outputs.description: Columns the query returns, in projection order.

fan_out.description: Iteration dimension an agent should warn about before running the query at scale.

related.description: Ids of related entries. Must resolve to existing entries.

last_verified.description: Date the query last executed successfully against a live provider. Maintained by the nightly verification job; set manually when first verified.
